## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Fix argument parsing before merge so users can put bare `--json` before `--junit` and still receive both reports.

## Changes
The pull request adds `--json` with an optional path that defaults to `results.json`. It also adds a helper that writes reports to the parsed destinations.

## Critical

- app/cli.py:15 — correctness — Leave the next option available to parse — With `--json --junit out.xml`, the JSON branch consumes `--junit` as its path, then rejects `out.xml` as an unknown option. — Users who put bare `--json` before a valid JUnit option receive neither report. — Fix: Apply the same `--` prefix check used for JUnit before consuming a JSON path.

## Important

- app/cli.py:30 — correctness — Reject a destination shared by both reports — With `--junit report.xml --json report.xml`, the second `write_text` call replaces the JUnit payload with JSON. — A caller that accidentally reuses a destination receives only the last report written. — Fix: Check for destination collisions before writing either report.

## Suggestions

- app/cli.py:29 — tests — Test writing to two distinct destinations — The existing tests leave `--junit out.xml --json out.json` unverified at the writer's second iteration. The only test that calls `write_reports` requests a single JSON destination. — A regression that stops after writing the first report would leave the second destination empty and pass the current tests.
